readings: For each film `rating`, count the inventory copies (every inventory record, matched to its film). Which ratings have more copies than the average of these counts across all ratings? Give one row with the total number of copies across those above-average ratings and the average amount by which their counts exceed the across-rating average, unrounded.
queries:
WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS copy_count
  FROM inventory AS i
  JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
rating_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(copy_count) AS avg_copy_count
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT
  SUM(rc.copy_count) AS total_copies,
  AVG(rc.copy_count - ra.avg_copy_count) AS avg_excess
FROM rating_counts AS rc
CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra
WHERE rc.copy_count > ra.avg_copy_count
